title: dilepyrum erectum
intro: Dilepyrum erectum, commonly known as Dillenia, is a plant species in the family Dilleniaceae. It is a tropical plant native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dillenia include its use in treating fever, cough, and respiratory infections, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of Dillenia include flavonoids, saponins, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
